title: Accreditation for journalists
html:
Faster at the fair – closer to the story: with online accreditation, you can acquire accreditation for the trade fair around the clock from February 2027 until the end of the event.

During the event Koelnmesse will ensure that your request will be processed within 2 hours during regular trade fair opening hours.

The registration must be undertaken personally by each media representative – there is no possibility of accreditation on site!

Your admission ticket and your public transport ticket will be available in your Ticket Wallet in the IDS app 14 days before the event begins at the latest.

Please observe the accreditation guidelines of Koelnmesse GmbH.

The accreditation of journalists for the purpose of reporting on Koelnmesse GmbH events is governed by Koelnmesse GmbH’s General Accreditation Guidelines for trade fairs in Germany, as described below.

We kindly ask all media representatives to observe these guidelines and seek accreditation in good time prior to the trade fair. An accreditation is granted solely for the purpose of journalistic reporting.

We are looking forward to your visit!
